title: Unit 9 Consolidation
goal: Review imagined situations, the -ra form of quisiera, polite requests, conditions and exceptions, and read a text about Isabel Allende and Cuentos de Eva Luna.
grammar: Review: potential scenarios, conditions and exceptions

items: Review si with the imperfect subjunctive and the conditional for imagined situations.
Review quisiera, pudiera and debiera and the polite requests with si.
Review siempre que, con tal de que, a menos que and salvo que.
Read a text about the writer Isabel Allende and her book Cuentos de Eva Luna.
I can imagine an unlikely present or future situation with si and the imperfect subjunctive.
I can use quisiera, pudiera and debiera and make polite requests with si and le agradecería que.
I can state a condition with siempre que, con tal de que and a condición de que, and an exception with a menos que and salvo que.
I can read a short text about Isabel Allende and her book Cuentos de Eva Luna.
